notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 - Conquer the World, or Don't... The Choice is Yours!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

An anticipated third installment in the Realpolitiks series has just launched to Early Access!

Watch the launch trailer here:

[previewyoutube=-kGI86dsYZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/][b]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/b][/url] is here to put you into office. You are cordially invited to prove your political brilliance - pick from a range of [b]195 countries[/b], set up your [b]government[/b] and navigate the pitfalls of [b]domestic and international politics[/b]. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of [b]not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system[/b]!

To achieve this ultimate goal, you will have to carefully consider a myriad of decisions, starting with the choice of a country you wish to lead. Taking control of any contemporary nation in order to fulfil your ambitions: from Afghanistan to Zimbabwe and everything in between. 

You will also need to select your optimal form of government, build your cabinet of ministers, improve your character’s skills - all while leading your country’s efforts in economic development, research, diplomacy, espionage or war. Will you lead your people to the stars, or to their ultimate doom?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url] is available now in Early Access - with three game modes currently available - Realism, Overdrive and Sandbox. You can currently begin your political empire on Earth, before slowly expanding out into the solar system - with the option to lead any country existing in 2010, the starting year of the campaign.

The game is available with a 15% Launch Discount until October 29, and to celebrate the release, the previous games in the series are discounted as well. Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/realpolitiksfranchise2024]Realpolitiks Franchise Sale[/url] to learn more, or simply purchase the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46403/]Realpolitiks Franchise Bundle[/url] to get the best deal!

If you're interested in the game, don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/ZwXekHkTDK]join the Realpolitiks HQ Discord server[/url] where you can chat with the developers and with other players too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Join The Battle Between Magic And Technology In New Arc Line!
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,

We have some especially exciting news for you! Fulqrum Publishing, along with the developers from Dreamate Games, have officially revealed their new project called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]New Arc Line[/url].

[b]Official Announcement Trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=ssM2CrCIbEE;full][/previewyoutube]

New Arc Line is a new single-player, story-rich RPG set during the gilded age of magic and technology, which will introduce you to a troubled society: 

The New World looms on the horizon and on its shore New Arc, the shining city of progress, the last beacon of hope in your search for a cure to your family's fatal disease. But you will soon discover that the city's beauty runs only skin-deep; tensions growing between different factions in the world of arcane magic and steampunk gadgets, the rich exploiting the poor, the humanoid hunting the monstrous, and in the middle of it all you, a stranger in a strange land, unaware of the role you have to play in shaping the future of this world... Which side will you choose? What will you become?

If that sounds interesting, make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]wishlist the game[/url] and visit its Steam store page to learn more details about New Arc Line.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/

And to find out even more about New Arc Line and stay up to date on its development, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/MCAYysT7N9]join the official New Arc Line Discord server[/url], we are looking forward to chatting with you there!

notes.title: The Pegasus Expedition needs you, Commander! Will you answer the call?
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone,

On behalf of the team here at 1C, we are happy to announce our collaboration with indie developer Kalla Gameworks to bring their upcoming 4X grand strategy, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url], to PC this year. Aspiring Fleet Commanders will soon be able to get a little taste of what it has to offer, as we can confirm [b]a playable demo will be available for you to enjoy during the upcoming Steam Next Fest, starting June 13, 2022![/b]

For now, you can at least take a look at the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url] trailer:

[previewyoutube=in1bLfzbgHk;full][/previewyoutube]

And if you like what you see, go ahead and wishlist the game, so you don't miss any news about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url] is a story-driven sci-fi grand strategy game set in a key moment for humankind’s survival. Facing an overwhelming threat at home, humanity sends an expedition to the Pegasus Galaxy in a desperate attempt to find a refuge for the population of Earth, only to find themselves in the middle of an interstellar war they inadvertently started.

As you lead one of these fleets, your mission soon transitions from exploration to governance, conquest, and eventually a fight for survival. Players will experience a challenging story where nothing is self-evident and every decision will have its consequences.

Building on the legacy of the grand strategy genre, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url] adds a strong narrative side to the classic 4X-gameplay which involves managing your diplomatic ties, armies, economy and scientific development.

We encourage you to come to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/1c-entertainment]Discord server[/url], just as the [url=https://discord.gg/CvsDfa28]developer's[/url], we will be happy to hear from you!

notes.title: Unofficial widescreen fix
notes.notes:
There is a way how to enable widescreen resolution for UFO: Aftershock, however it's not an official one. If you decide to mod your game, you are doing it on your own risk - just a friendly warning :)

Here's a simple guide:

1) Visit: http://70.40.217.138/UFOAS/

2) Find the resolution you are looking for

3) Download a file for 1.21 version (1.3 is only through an unofficial patch and not available on Steam)

4) Make a backup of your original UFO.exe file (located in your Steam folder under \steamapps\common\UFO Aftershock

5) Extract UFO.exe and screenXXXX.vfs files to your main game directory

6) Play the game
